events.name: Bash
events.head: Survey the features pipeline files, git state and decision log
events.input: $ F=workshop-plan/tasks/features && ls -la $F $F/data $F/data/decisions $F/changelog 2>&1 | head -60; wc -l $F/*.py docs/feature-rubric.md workshop-plan/feedback-intake/features_feed.py; git status --short -- $F docs/feature-rubric.md workshop-plan/coord/LOG.md workshop-plan/tasks/tasks.json workshop-plan/feedback-intake | head; git log --oneline -8 -- $F docs/feature-rubric.md; git fetch -q origin 2>&1 | tail -1; git rev-list --count origin/main..main; grep -n "T-153\|feature decision\|Feature decision\|features" workshop-plan/coord/LOG.md | head -10

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the rubric and the scoring, weekly and changelog code
events.input: $ cat docs/feature-rubric.md; cd workshop-plan/tasks/features && cat score.py weekly.py changelog.py

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the rest of the rubric and all pipeline code
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign && sed -n 18,45p docs/feature-rubric.md | cut -c1-400; cd workshop-plan/tasks/features && cat score.py weekly.py changelog.py reqstore.py test_features.py; cat changelog/CHANGELOG.md data/releases.json; ls ../../retention/data 2>&1 | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the intake feed, list stored requests and the decision file
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan && cat feedback-intake/features_feed.py; grep -n "features_feed\|features" feedback-intake/server.py | head -20; python3 -c "

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the store, scorer, weekly and changelog code
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan/tasks/features && cat reqstore.py score.py weekly.py changelog.py | cut -c1-260

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read seed and tests, changelog output, store history
events.input: $ cat seed.py test_features.py | cut -c1-200 | grep -v "^    (\"" ; cat changelog/CHANGELOG.md; git log --oneline -5 -- data/requests.json; git diff --stat HEAD -- data | tail -2

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the merger half of the store

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read scorer, weekly job and changelog code
events.input: $ sed -n 1,20p score.py | cut -c1-200; sed -n 31,51p score.py | cut -c1-200; cat weekly.py changelog.py | cut -c1-220

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read seed tail, tests, changelog output and store history
events.input: $ sed -n 22,48p seed.py | cut -c1-200 | grep -v '^ ("'; cut -c1-170 test_features.py; cat changelog/CHANGELOG.md | cut -c1-200; git log --oneline -5 -- data/requests.json; git status --short -- .

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run feature tests, find what schedules the weekly job, scan for dashes, check intake rows
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign && python3 -m pytest -q workshop-plan/tasks/features/test_features.py 2>&1 | tail -2; grep -rn "features/weekly\|features\.weekly\|weekly\.run\|features/changelog.py\|import weekly" --include=*.py --include=*.sh --include=*.json --include=*.plist --include=*.md workshop-plan docs .claude 2>/dev/null | grep -v "activity/\|tasks.json\|inbox\|test_features\|/memory/" | cut -c1-220 | head -15; grep -nP "[\x{2013}\x{2014}]" docs/feature-rubric.md workshop-plan/tasks/features/*.py workshop-plan/tasks/features/changelog/CHANGELOG.md | head -5; sqlite3 -readon

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find intake database path and any weekly scheduler in the command center
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan && grep -n "DB\b\|\.db\|sqlite" feedback-intake/store.py | head -6; grep -c "[–—]" ../docs/feature-rubric.md; grep -rn "def .*sched\|weekday()\|every week\|WEEKLY" tasks/*.py 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-160 | head -12; ls tasks/*.plist tasks/launchd 2>/dev/null | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Look for the recurring job mechanism and how the pipeline page reads feature data
events.input: $ grep -rln "hygiene\|retention/report\|report\.py" tasks/*.py ops/*.py retention/*.py 2>/dev/null | head; grep -n "def \|86400\|weekday\|strftime(\"%a\|%u" tasks/scheduler.py tasks/jobs.py tasks/cron.py 2>/dev/null | head -30; ls tasks/*.py | tr '\n' ' ' | cut -c1-900; ls feedback-intake/data 2>&1 | head -4; grep -n "features\|releases\|decisions" pipeline/dash.py | cut -c1-200 | head -20

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find how recurring jobs are scheduled in this repo
events.input: $ ls retention | head; grep -rlE "crontab|LaunchAgents|StartCalendarInterval|every_day|daily\(" --include="*.py" --include="*.sh" --include="*.plist" . 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head -10; grep -nE "def (tick|loop|daily|periodic|main)|time\.sleep|hygiene" tasks/runner.py | cut -c1-170 | head -20; crontab -l 2>/dev/null | head -5; ls ~/Library/LaunchAgents 2>/dev/null | grep -i -E "tantra|workshop|launch" | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the weekly pipeline schedule and check it is loaded
events.input: $ grep -v "^<?xml\|DOCTYPE" ops/com.tantra.pipeline-weekly.plist | cut -c1-200; ls ~/Library/LaunchAgents | grep -c pipeline-weekly; launchctl list 2>/dev/null | grep -i tantra | head -12; grep -rn "retention/report\|signals.json" --include="*.py" . 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-140 | head -5; ls pipeline | head -12

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect the dashboard snapshot entry point and locate the retention report
events.input: $ grep -n "snapshot\|^def \|^import\|^from\|__main__" pipeline/dash.py | cut -c1-170 | head -40; git log --oneline -3 --all -- retention/report.py | head; git ls-files | grep -i "retention.*report\|retention/" | head -5; ls retention/data/snapshots | head -3; git status --short -- pipeline | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check the retention commit contents and read dashboard feature code
events.input: $ git show --stat --format=%s 7a96aef | cut -c1-120 | head -14; find .. -name "report.py" -path "*retention*" -not -path "*/node_modules/*" 2>/dev/null | head -3; sed -n 39,50p pipeline/dash.py | cut -c1-220; sed -n 92,110p pipeline/dash.py | cut -c1-230; sed -n 152,168p pipeline/dash.py | cut -c1-200
